title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Brown University
description: From student-run grill stations to Thayer Street staples, these late-night spots fuel the Brown community long after the libraries close.

cards.title: Josiah's (Jo's)
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Grill in Vartan Gregorian Quad
cards.notes: Order the signature spicy with cheese at this student-favorite grill, which serves as a social hub for late-night study breaks until 2 AM.
cards.short_summary: A quintessential Brown late-night dining spot known for burgers and fries.
cards.evidence_claim: Josiah's is open everyday from 6 PM to 2 AM at 114 Power Street.
cards.access_notes: Open until 2:00 AM daily during the academic semester.

cards.title: Baja's Tex Mex Grill
cards.subtitle: Thayer Street Burritos
cards.notes: Visit this Thayer Street staple for late-night burritos and quesadillas; it is a primary destination for students after the campus cafes close.
cards.short_summary: A popular Mexican grill on Thayer Street open until the early morning hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Baja's Tex Mex Grill at 273 Thayer Street is open daily from 10 AM to 2 AM.

cards.title: East Side Pockets
cards.subtitle: Middle Eastern Fare on Thayer
cards.notes: Grab a falafel wrap or gyro at this award-winning spot, which has been a Thayer Street fixture for Brown students since 1997.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing Middle Eastern restaurant known for quick service and late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: East Side Pockets is open until late night Monday through Saturday and until 10 PM on Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight or later most nights; check current daily schedule.

cards.title: Antonio's Pizza
cards.subtitle: Creative Slices on Thayer
cards.notes: Try unique toppings like Mac & Cheese or Tortellini on your pizza slice at this bustling late-night corner spot near campus.
cards.short_summary: A Thayer Street pizzeria famous for its wide variety of creative slice combinations.
cards.evidence_claim: Antonio's Pizza at 256 Thayer Street is open daily from 11:00 AM to 1:30 AM.
cards.source_title: Antonio's Pizza by the Slice - Thayer Street District

cards.title: The Ivy Room
cards.subtitle: Vegetarian-Friendly Late Dining
cards.notes: Head to the lower level of the Sharpe Refectory for smoothies and vegetarian-focused dinner specials during late-night hours.
cards.short_summary: A retail dining location at Brown offering fresh, vegetarian-friendly evening options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ivy Room is open for dinner Sunday through Thursday from 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10:00 PM on weeknights and Sundays.

cards.title: Andrews Commons
cards.subtitle: North Campus Late-Night Hub
cards.notes: Utilize the pizza station or wok at this North Campus facility, which serves as a major late-night study and dining space for students.
cards.short_summary: A modern dining and study common area located in the Andrews Residence Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Andrews Commons offers dinner and late-night options on weekdays and weekends.
cards.access_notes: Open for dinner and late-night service; check BrownU Mobile app for exact nightly closing.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Bakery
cards.notes: Order warm cookies for delivery or pickup until the early morning hours at this Thayer Street bakery catering to late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: A bakery specializing in late-night cookie delivery and walk-in service.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies on Thayer Street typically serves customers until 1 AM or later.
cards.source_title: A guide to Thayer Street's late-night eats
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 AM or later daily.

cards.title: Mike's Calzones
cards.subtitle: Thayer Street Deli & Grill
cards.notes: Choose from a wide variety of calzones and sandwiches at this Thayer Street spot that remains open well past midnight for the student crowd.
cards.short_summary: A casual eatery on Thayer Street specializing in calzones and late-night comfort food.
cards.evidence_claim: Mike's Calzones is listed as a top late-night option on Thayer Street, often open past midnight.
cards.source_title: A guide to Thayer Street's late-night eats
cards.access_notes: Open late daily; typically until 1:00 AM or 2:00 AM.

cards.title: Zinneken's Waffles
cards.subtitle: Authentic Belgian Waffles
cards.notes: Enjoy authentic pearl sugar waffles with various toppings at this Angell Street cafe, popular for evening dessert runs.
cards.short_summary: A Belgian waffle cafe located near the heart of Brown's campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Zinneken's at 194 Angell Street is open for online ordering and pickup until 9:40 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:40 PM or 10:00 PM most nights.

cards.title: Blue Room Cafe
cards.subtitle: Campus Center Gathering Spot
cards.notes: While primarily a daytime spot, the Blue Room in the Stephen Robert '62 Campus Center is the central meeting point for students between late-afternoon sessions.
cards.short_summary: A central campus cafe known for its sandwiches, pastries, and community atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Room is located in the Stephen Robert '62 Campus Center at 75 Waterman Street.
cards.source_title: Blue Room Cafe | Dining | Brown University
cards.access_notes: Standard hours are 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM; serves as a key transition spot for evening activities.
